```{r}
Nm<-read_csv("/Volumes/whipple_lab/Users/cwhilden/PIPELINE/ribomethseq/data/mouseNmSites.csv") %>%
  mutate(ID=paste(TARGET,POSITION,sep="_"))
```

rRNA 
```{r}
dataFiles<-list.files(path = RMS_dir, 
                        pattern = "\\.rms.txt$", 
                        full.names = TRUE)

# Extract sample/snoRNA information from filename
names<-sub("\\.rms.txt$","",basename(dataFiles))

# generate a named list of data
data <- purrr::set_names(dataFiles, names) %>%
  purrr::map(~ readr::read_tsv(.x))
  
aseD=11953
aseDp=10413

# Merge named list into a single data frame
merged_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(data, .id = "sample")  %>%
  tidyr::separate(sample, 
                  into = c("condition", "tissue", "sampleid"), 
                  sep  = "_") %>%
  filter(chrom=='45S_Rn45s') %>%
  mutate(
    ID    = paste(chrom, position, sep = "_"),
    status = if_else(ID %in% Nm$ID, 'known Nm', 'unknown'),
    aseD  = abs(position - aseD),
    aseDp = abs(position - aseDp)) %>%
    mutate(site_status=case_when(position>=10415 & position<=10427 ~ "aseD",
                         position>=11961 & position<=11971 ~ "aseDp",
                         status == 'known Nm' ~ 'Nm',
                
                         TRUE ~ "other"),
           group=paste0(condition,"_")) %>%
  filter(coverage>=10000,
         )

```

```{r}
# Summary table: mean RMS and SEM per position and condition
rms_summary <- merged_data %>%
  group_by(chrom, position, ID, status, condition, aseD, aseDp) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rms = mean(RMS, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_rms   = sd(RMS, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n        = n(),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) 

# Pivot wider so CTL and KD are separate columns for scatter plot
rms_wide <- rms_summary %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(position, ID, status, aseD, aseDp),
    names_from  = condition,
    values_from = c(mean_rms, se_rms)
  )

rms_Nm <- rms_wide %>%
  filter(status=='known Nm') 



# Scatter plot CTL vs KD with error bars
ggplot(rms_Nm,
       aes(x     = mean_rms_CTL,
           y     = mean_rms_KD,
           color = status)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_rms_KD - se_rms_KD,
        ymax = mean_rms_KD + se_rms_KD),
    width   = 0,
    alpha   = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = mean_rms_CTL - se_rms_CTL,
        xmax = mean_rms_CTL + se_rms_CTL),
    height  = 0,
    alpha   = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_abline(slope     = 1,
              intercept = 0,
              linetype  = "dashed",
              color     = "grey50") +   # identity line
  labs(
    x     = "CTL mean RMS",
    y     = "KD mean RMS",
    color = "Status",
    title = "CTL vs KD RMS Score by Position"
  ) 

```

```{r}
merged_Nm<- merged_data %>%
  mutate(sampleFull=paste(condition,tissue,sampleid,sep='_')) %>%
  filter(status=='known Nm') %>%
  mutate(
    condition  = factor(condition, levels = c("KD", "DEL", "CTL")),
    sampleFull = fct_reorder(sampleFull, as.numeric(condition))
  )

ggplot(merged_Nm,
       aes(x    = factor(position),
           y    = sampleFull,
           fill = RMS)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low     = "blue",
    mid     = "white",
    high    = "red",
    midpoint = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ tissue, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x    = "45S rRNA pos: known Nm",
    y    = "Sample",
    fill = "RMS Score",
    title = "RMS Score by Position and Sample"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size=4))
```

# Nm and ase sites on one plot
```{r}
all_summary <- merged_data %>%
  filter(site_status != 'other') %>%
  mutate(group=paste0(condition,"_",tissue)) %>%
  group_by(chrom, position, ID, site_status, group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rms = mean(RMS, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_rms   = sd(RMS, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n        = n(),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) 

# Pivot wider so CTL and KD are separate columns for scatter plot
wide <- all_summary %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(position, ID, site_status),
    names_from  = group,
    values_from = c(mean_rms, se_rms)
  )


ggplot(wide,
       aes(x     = mean_rms_CTL_CTX,
           y     = mean_rms_DEL_CTX,
           color = site_status)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_rms_DEL_CTX - se_rms_DEL_CTX,
        ymax = mean_rms_DEL_CTX + se_rms_DEL_CTX),
    width   = 0,
    alpha   = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = mean_rms_CTL_CTX - se_rms_CTL_CTX,
        xmax = mean_rms_CTL_CTX + se_rms_CTL_CTX),
    height  = 0,
    alpha   = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_abline(slope     = 1,
              intercept = 0,
              linetype  = "dashed",
              color     = "grey50") +   # identity line
  labs(
    x     = "CTL mean RMS",
    y     = "DEL mean RMS",
    color = "Status",
    title = "CTL vs DEL cortex"
  ) 


```
